answer: Neighbor-quorum bond: each identity locks 70 credits and files an umber-stamped declaration naming five neighbors, who countersign with copper-bound keys. An auditor replays the ledger; one key signing two declarations, or a forged stamp, burns both bonds. First 38, k-th 38+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,035,000 against a 40,000 pool. A rented-neighbor ring fails: a rented key signs twice. An honest agent pays 38 once and sips nectar each clean epoch.
